mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees with overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. We have a waxing crescent moon out, and while the ISS is passing over tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 53 degrees with no rain forecast.

Important update regarding local elections: the City of Verona has added two new polling locations to help streamline the process. Residents should visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm their current ward and designated polling place, as your location may have changed.

There is plenty happening in town today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and the Downtown Farmer's Market. You can also grab pizza at the Wisconsin Brewing Company or join a trivia night at either The Mill or The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, officers responded to a motorcycle crash on October 5 on Highway 18/151 involving a 19-year-old male who was transported to the hospital.
Today's flavor was Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently closed for the night, but we will be back open tomorrow at 10:00 AM featuring Crazy for Cookie Dough.
